itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International and taken to the hotel; Cairo rewards a night's rest before it is confronted.

itinerary.title: Fly to Luxor, Karnak, board cruise
itinerary.source: You fly south to Luxor on day two and board the cruise upriver to Aswan.

itinerary.title: Second Luxor day crosses the river
itinerary.source: The second Luxor day crosses the river.

itinerary.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: The fourth day moors at Edfu in the morning.

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel and Aswan
itinerary.source: The fifth day is the longest.

itinerary.title: Philae, flight to Cairo
itinerary.source: From Aswan, a domestic flight returns you to Cairo.

itinerary.title: Memphis, Saqqara and Giza
itinerary.source: Day seven reaches back to the beginning of monumental building in Egypt.

itinerary.title: Drive east into Sinai
itinerary.source: The eighth day moves east into Sinai, and the landscape changes entirely.

itinerary.title: Mount Sinai ascent and St. Catherine's Monastery
itinerary.source: The ascent of Mount Sinai begins before dawn.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Sharm el-Sheikh
itinerary.source: Day ten transfers to Sharm el-Sheikh at the tip of the Sinai Peninsula, where the Gulf of Aqaba meets the Gulf of Suez.

itinerary.title: Second Sharm day on the reef
itinerary.source: The Red Sea holds one of the finest reef systems in the world, and the second Sharm day is for it — or not, as you prefer.

itinerary.title: Return to Cairo for final day
itinerary.source: You return to Cairo for the final full day.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo International
itinerary.source: After breakfast the next morning, you are transferred to Cairo International.
